description: Checks that a value is well formed and returns its parts, or the reason it is not. Kinds: phone (mobile, landline, VoIP), rib (any bank, 20 digits), rip (Algerie Poste RIP), ccp (account number, with 'key' to check), plate (vehicle plate), postal (postal code), nin, nif, nis, rc (registre du commerce number), wilaya, commune (with 'wilaya' to pick among shared names). Well formed does not mean the account, line or company exists; NIN, NIF, NIS and RC have no public check key.

key.description: For ccp: the two-digit key to check

wilaya.description: For commune: the wilaya, by code or name

name: validate
title: Check an Algerian format
